theme: An open Sunday, and the girls come home tonight.
greeting: One fifteen-minute board review with Mike at nine, Dan, and then the day is wide open. It's a handoff Sunday — the girls come back to you and Mike this evening, so the quiet won't last.

needsAttention.title: Recruiter waiting on your CIFIC answer
needsAttention.detail: Amin Noorani of Noorani + Partners followed up Oct 15 on the VP, Government Relations & Regulatory Affairs search at CIFIC and said he'd 'be happy to discuss it further should you wish to consider it' — still unread, no reply sent.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV still isn't booked
needsAttention.detail: Your p1 item on the Mike + Dan board has sat since Sept 14: a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week, the hardest rental in that market over the holidays. The 9 AM review is the moment to finally hold it.

needsAttention.title: December break is past its book-by
needsAttention.detail: The p2 board item set a decide-by of Sept 30 and a book-by of Oct 15, now three days gone, for all four girls over a 21-day window. Settle domestic vs. international at the review before inventory for six thins out.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive window ends today
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5-18 window to bring the Pathfinder down from Portland to St. Pete closes today — it's the only Maine car that seats all six, and the girls are back with you tonight.

schedule.title: Sunday review with Mike
schedule.detail: Fifteen minutes to clear what's slipped and promote this week's work.

flagged.title: Brunswick interviews locked for Oct 27
flagged.detail: Two Teams calls are confirmed: Jonathan Doorley at 10am, Christian Buss at 1:30pm, Oct 27.

flagged.title: Dropbox over its storage limit
flagged.detail: Dropbox warns files get deleted after Oct 25 unless you free space or upgrade.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley account to fund
flagged.detail: A reminder to make the initial deposit on your new Signature Savings account.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promotions — Breeze, Airbnb, a Japanese color book, Italian word-of-the-week, local St. Pete listings.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on your reply.

recipe.why: A warming autumn braise that leans on the beans and hardy greens coming into their own this season.

acts.line: One fifteen-minute review with Mike at nine, then the morning opens up.
Nothing on the calendar — the long, unhurried middle of a Sunday.
The handoff lands around six; the house fills back up with the girls.
